title: 纽约交通机构拟发7.85亿美元地产税收支持债券
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: New York City's Transit Network, the MTA, is planning to offer $785 million of debt backed by a levy on real estate sales.
segments.zh: 纽约市交通网络MTA计划发行7.85亿美元债券，以地产交易税作为担保。

segments.en: Bloomberg's Michelle Kaskie has been reporting on the story and she joins us now.
segments.zh: 彭博社的Michelle Kaskie一直在报道此事，现在她加入我们。

segments.en: And it's not just any real estate sale. It's a specific real estate, isn't it?
segments.zh: 这可不是普通的地产交易，而是特定类型的地产，对吧？

segments.en: Definitely. It's the high end. It's the luxury residential and non-residential portion of the real estate market in New York City.
segments.zh: 没错，是高端市场，纽约市地产市场中的豪华住宅和非住宅部分。

segments.en: And this is a way for the MTA to raise new money to help improve its infrastructure.
segments.zh: 这是MTA筹集新资金以改善基础设施的一种方式。

segments.en: What defines high-end real estate, luxury real estate here? Definitely. So these are sales of luxury residential units that are worth two million or more.
segments.zh: 这里如何定义高端地产、豪华地产？没错，就是价值200万美元或以上的豪华住宅单元的交易。

segments.en: So whenever there's a sale, there's a transaction, there's a tax on that, and then the MTA gets a portion of that tax revenue, so it can do things like improve train signals and help to modernize
segments.zh: 所以每当有交易发生，就会产生税收，MTA获得部分税收收入，用于改善列车信号和推动系统现代化。

segments.en: the system. Okay, all things that are needed, is this the same thing or is this separate from the Piotta Territax that Zora Momdani, the New York City mayor, is trying to put in place?
segments.zh: 好的，这些都是需要的。这与纽约市长Zora Momdani试图推行的Piotta Territax是同一回事还是分开的？

segments.en: It's separate, but there is a little bit of overlap there for people that live in and own these types of properties. So the bonds that are being sold today by the MTA,
segments.zh: 是分开的，但对于居住和拥有这类地产的人来说有一点重叠。所以MTA今天发行的债券，

segments.en: they're repaid with this real estate tax revenue that an owner would pay when there's an actual sale of the property. The Piotta Territax tax is a different levy that the mayor is imposing,
segments.zh: 是用地产实际出售时所有者支付的地产税收入来偿还的。Piotta Territax税是市长征收的另一种税，
